# sars/emp201/ (EMP201 page sections)

Split from `pages/accounting/sars/emp201.tsx` (wave 5 L2, pure move). The page keeps the state and the legacy save-draft / record-as-filed calls; these files render.

## Caller contract
`Emp201ReturnForm` renders the form card from `EMP201Data` (`emp201Types.ts`, the `GET /api/accounting/sars/sars-emp201` payload). One file per field section, so the later wave-5 PRs edit only their own rows:
- `Emp201EmployeeSection`, `Emp201PayeSection`, `Emp201EtiSection` (ETI and PAYE payable; ET adds the carry-forward row here), `Emp201UifSdlSection`, `Emp201TotalSection`. L3u adds drill links in these files.
- `Emp201PageHeader`, `Emp201PeriodSelector`, `Emp201RunsBreakdown`, `Emp201SubmitModal`; `exportEmp201Csv` and `getDefaultPeriod` in `emp201Types.ts`.

## Business rules
- Sections are fragments inside the card's `divide-y` list: return rows, not a wrapper element.

## Recent changes
- 2026-11-11: created by the L2 split; the lifecycle bar mounts on the page (`../returns/`).
